slides.label: Real job: turret camera under the fascia

slides.title: GUESS THE PRICE
slides.body: 4 Lorex wired cameras, recorder with a 2TB drive, mounting, wiring and app setup
Installed, plus tax. Our Brooklyn price for a 4-camera Lorex wired system.

slides.title: What's included
slides.body: 4 Lorex 4MP PoE cameras, 8-channel recorder, 2TB for 2+ weeks of recording, wire runs up to 100 ft per camera, phone app setup.

slides.title: Why it costs that
slides.body: Bensonhurst is brick. Drilling masonry and sealing every entry is real labor. Hidden in-wall wiring in drywall is $200 more per camera.
